requirement_plain_english: Passwords follow current NIST guidance (length over complexity, no forced rotation, block common/breached passwords)
where_to_look: Password policy, interview: IT Manager, AD export

requirement_plain_english: MFA is required for all users on email, remote access (VPN), and admin accounts
where_to_look: M365 MFA report, interview: IT Manager, insurer requirements

requirement_plain_english: Accounts are disabled promptly when people leave, and company equipment is returned
where_to_look: HR terminations vs. AD export, laptop inventory, interview: HR Director

requirement_plain_english: Admin rights are limited to people who need them; every admin uses their own named account (no shared accounts)
where_to_look: Domain Admins export, M365 report, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: User access is reviewed at least once a year
All systems run software the vendor still supports
Security patches are applied on time (within 30 days)
where_to_look: Laptop inventory, server inventory, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: Laptops are encrypted, especially any that may hold CUI
CUI and company data are stored and shared only on approved systems (no personal cloud accounts)
where_to_look: Interview: Gov Programs, vendor list, acceptable use policy

requirement_plain_english: Backups are monitored, kept in a separate location, and test-restored at least once a year
where_to_look: Backup job log, server inventory, interview: IT Manager

requirement_plain_english: All employees complete security awareness training every year; CUI handlers also complete CUI training
where_to_look: Training completion report, interview: HR Director

requirement_plain_english: A current incident response plan exists, is reviewed yearly, and is tested
Incidents are documented and reported to everyone who must be told (DFARS: 72 hours)
where_to_look: the-incident.md, Northstar letter, interview: Gov Programs

requirement_plain_english: Security logs are kept long enough and reviewed regularly
Vendors with access to sensitive data are reviewed for security before and during the contract
Security policies have an owner, are approved, and are reviewed every year
A System Security Plan (SSP) describes the systems that handle CUI and how each requirement is met
Known security gaps are tracked in a Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) or risk register
An accurate inventory shows every device and where CUI is stored
where_to_look: Laptop and server inventories, interview: Gov Programs

requirement_plain_english: EDR or antivirus runs on every laptop and server
New hires are background-checked before they start
Physical access to the office is controlled and visitors are logged
Firewall rules are reviewed on a schedule
